messages.author: c621ac38989fbf3c
messages.subject: 3-dimensional smooth
parts:
Is there a way to do a 3-way smooth for an SPDE model?

I've got a model that in mgcv and in brms I'm calling using s( long , lat , month ) where month is a sequence of 72 consecutive months.

Thanks,
Paul

messages.author: 66ed4f72a898a51c
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] 3-dimensional smooth
parts:
One option is described in
https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s10182-012-0196-3

You can follow the supplementary code for this paper or in
http://www.r-inla.org/examples/tutorials/spde-tutorial. New options are
coming as well.

Elias
